name: MACRO
full_name: Monopole, Astrophysics and Cosmic Ray Observatory
summary: Historical multipurpose underground experiment indirectly searching for WIMPs through upward-going muons from the Sun and Earth's core.
physics_targets: WIMPs captured in the Sun / Earth
detection_principle: Underground liquid-scintillator timing and tracking reconstruct upward-going muons; cosmic-ray and atmospheric-neutrino backgrounds are used to estimate dark-matter signal limits.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: The collaboration paper's historical cumulative data cover 1989-02 to 2000-12; this is not a 2026 operating status.

timeline.event: Start of cumulative cosmic-ray muon data in the cited paper
End of cumulative data in the cited paper

key_parameters.name: Historical cumulative sample
key_parameters.value: About 60 million secondary cosmic-ray muons; not a WIMP-candidate count

results.summary: No significant excess was found toward the Sun or Earth's core; upper limits were placed on upward-going muon fluxes and neutralino parameters.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
